CMD_USERS: List all users. First argument is rows limit (default to 10) or _part of name_ search query.
CMD_REGISTER: Register new user. First argument is WA number that starts with 62. Second arguments is optional user name. The second argument can be *--toggle-active* to toggle user active status by its number.
CMD_COMPRESS: Compress an attached (or reply sent) document (video or image) for Status.
CMD_FFMPEG: Run the *ffmpeg* command with the attached (or reply sent) document. The first argument is the output file extension and the remaining arguments are *ffmpeg* parameters. For example: *!ffmpeg mp4 -r 30 -preset medium*.
CMD_MONEY: Track your income and expenses. Syntax: *!money <amount> <yyyy-mm-dd date?> <description>*. Example: *!money -17000 Buy milk* or  *!money 150000 2025-09-24 Got donation*. Note: Date is optional that default to current date. Use a minus sign (-) for expenses. To get recaps, *!money recap* or *!money recap with <user id>* or *!money recap all* (group only). To get list, *!money list*. You will receive a daily reminder. To configure it, use: *!money reminder <disabled|0|enabled|1>*
CMD_DL: Download a video from the given URL. Syntax: *!dl <url>*. Add *compress* after the URL to compress the video for WhatsApp Status. You can also compress the file later by quote-replying to it with the compress command.
